title: Kya Shaam thi wo Shaam e Gharibaan
body:
Haaye..
Haaye..
Haye shaam e gharibaa'n
Shaam e gharibaa'n, aye shaam e gharibaa'n
So chuka tha lashkar, ro raha tha darya
jalte hue khaimo ki pehre daar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Arey, jalti zamee'n par aale abaa thi..(2)
karbobala bhi mehwe buka thi..(2)
sadaat is aalam mein the lachaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Arey, Zere alam baithi thi sakina..(2)
dhundh rahi thi baba ka seena..(2)
koi na tha us bacchi ka ghumkhwaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Arey, Ranjo alam ka bojh uthakar..(2)
abid ko sholo se bachakar..(2)
tanha bhare kunbe ki matamdaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Arey, jal gaye khaime chhin gayi chadar..(2)
is aalam mein aagaye Haider..(2)
ye dekh ke rone lage zarozaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Arey, ek sina par behen ki chadar..(2)
ek naize par bhai ka sar..(2)
ye dekh ke hai rone lagi ek baar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Arey, milke gale sajjad aur baqer..(2)
rone lage sajjad aur baqer..(2)
kehte the tadapkar haaye pardadaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Arey, majlis mein sab mehwe buka hai..(2)
mazhar aur irfan e azaa hai..(2)
sar peet ke kehte hai matamdaar, alamdaar
<<MINI>>
thi zainab e tashnakaam, kya shaam
kya shaam thi wo shaam e gharibaa'n
jalte khaime aur dhuaa'n
kya shaam, kya shaam..(2)
